items.title: Topview Launches Film Studio Hybrid AI Production Platform
items.excerpt: Singapore AI video company Topview's new Film Studio platform relights live-action footage, adds camera angles and AI extras, and swaps greenscreens around real actors; co-founder Jensen Wu pitches the hybrid approach as a route to mainstream distribution that fully AI films can't reach.

items.title: AI Filmmaking Gets Its Awards Season: The Chroma Awards Return for a Bigger Second Year
items.excerpt: The Chroma Awards, a competition for AI-made films, return for a larger second edition, with submissions open to creators worldwide through Jan. 7, 2027.

items.title: What Happens When Documentary Makers Sell Their Footage to AI Aggregators?
items.excerpt: Documentary producers and archivists lay out the dos and don'ts of licensing archival footage to AI training-data aggregators, and how those sales affect the research resources filmmakers rely on.

items.title: Christopher Nolan and Guillermo del Toro Break Down 'The Odyssey' Monsters and AI's Limitations with Production VFX Supervisor Andrew Jackson
items.excerpt: In a VFX Q&A on 'The Odyssey', Nolan, VFX supervisor Andrew Jackson and del Toro argue AI needs human oversight in compositing and animation; del Toro calls VFX the craft 'assailed the fastest' by AI. Craft-stance commentary, not a release.

items.title: Hollywood Is in Love With AI. Gen Z Has a Far Messier Relationship
items.excerpt: Younger audiences use AI tools daily but push back hard on AI in films and media; TheWrap looks at the gap between studio AI enthusiasm and Gen Z viewers' resistance.

items.title: Westworld rebuilds the TV-drama creature pipeline with AI sources and VFX compositing
items.excerpt: At ICNX 2026, Westworld's Lim Ju-young showed how a TV-drama lion was made from AI source plates plus VFX compositing in 1-2 weeks versus four months in CG; raw AI output can't be delivered, so AI must run inside the VFX pipeline.

items.title: Hudson AI bets on dubbing quality to take K-content abroad
items.excerpt: Hudson AI CEO Shin Hyun-jin said at ICNX 2026 that dubbing costs 10x subtitles and AI can carry long-tail K-content abroad; after Amazon's AI-dub backlash, quality decides the market, and Hudson is building an agentic workflow to cut human QC.

items.title: A Korean AI 3D film screens in cinema's birthplace: Visual Center's "Cinema Genesis" in France
items.excerpt: 'Cinema Genesis', an AI-made 3D short by Busan's Visual Center with ETRI and the Busan International Short Film Festival, screened in the AI film competition at France's Courant3D; AI restored 19th-century photos to 4K and converted 2D to 3D.

items.title: Could This AI-Powered Operating System Actually Speed Up Your Video Production Flows?
items.excerpt: A look at Lemonlight's Hero, a new AI production operating system that promises to unify production management and generative AI in a single platform.

items.title: 이스트소프트, AI 더빙으로 K-콘텐츠 중남미 5개국 진출…2년간 300시간 현지화
items.excerpt: ESTsoft used AI dubbing to localize 300 hours of Korean broadcast content over two years under the government's K-FAST AI-dubbing program, and opened two FAST channels serving five Latin American countries.

items.title: 구글, 나를 닮은 AI 영상 아바타 무료 제공…개인 영상 제작 문턱 낮춘다
items.excerpt: Google opened the Personal Avatars feature in its AI video tool Google Vids to free personal accounts, letting users create avatars with their own face and voice for video without a shoot.

items.title: AI가 배우를 대체할 수 있을까…프롬, 배우·감독·제작자 참여 'AI 명작 감상회' 개최
items.excerpt: AI storytelling lab PROM holds its second 'AI masterpiece screening' on Nov. 22 in Seoul on 'AI acting and the essence of the actor', screening AI-character works with scene-by-scene analysis and talks by actors, directors and producers. Event preview.

items.title: How We Built CorridorKey 2.0 | Live Demo & Q&A
items.excerpt: Corridor's Niko and developer Zach Harris break down how they built CorridorKey 2.0, the studio's custom-model AI keying tool, with a live demo and Q&A (sponsored by NVIDIA and Puget Systems).

items.title: Tool Tip Tuesday for Adobe Premiere: Color Matching with the AI Assistant (Beta)
items.excerpt: Jeff Greenberg walks through color matching shots with the AI Assistant beta in Adobe Premiere 2027, released at Adobe MAX. Tutorial; Adobe MAX follow-ups are saturated.

items.title: OpenAI Shut Down Sora. Kuaishou Is Betting Bigger on Kling.
items.excerpt: With OpenAI's Sora shut down, Kuaishou is doubling down on its Kling video model; TechNode/Jumpstart analysis of Kling's position. Business-leaning; Kling deprioritized.

items.title: Envato's 2nd Annual AI Report Finds Adoption Has Outrun the Rules
items.excerpt: Envato's survey of 1,033 creatives finds 58% use AI daily, 53% of users have put AI on client work without telling the client, and most team creatives have no written AI policy.

items.title: Tilly Norwood Creator Teases 'Storm Dogs' With Rob Minkoff & Shows Clip
items.excerpt: At the British Screen Forum, Particle6's Eline Van der Velden showed a clip of the AI-assisted 'Storm Dogs' with Lion King co-director Rob Minkoff, mixing real actors with AI toddlers and dogs; 'AI might reduce your budget by 50% but it won't go to 0%'. Storm Dogs was covered before, so this is a follow-up.
